proof_bundle: Inclusion proof bundle for leaves available in the last published Merkle root, with leaf hashes, indexes, proof paths, the Merkle root and signed card count. Not a grade.
receipts_batch: Historical measurement-card batch from published roots for a requested time window, capped at 200 leaves, with inclusion paths and carrying roots. Not payment or settlement receipts.
request_attestation: A card-v0 commission receipt for one named subject: SHA-256 content-addressed and Ed25519-signed by did:web:csoai.org#board-attestation-1 when available, otherwise sig_ed25519:null with unsigned_reason. Check csoai.signer before paying. Paid reserve returns up to 24 card-v1 references from dated /signed/card-matrix.json only; reserve_count covers that corpus. The separate interop root in the free preview is not included in the paid reserve. Payment never creates a MEASURED board cell.
pop_stablecoins: Stablecoin universe slice — every asset the frozen discovery index catalogues, with each reader's per-chain deployment reads and every unmeasured asset's own reason. Assets, never supply; a read, not a reserve attestation.
pop_swift: SWIFT-linked bank census slice — every bank named in a dated public notice about the Swift digital-asset MVP, in its notice's own state (LIVE, COMMITTED, DISCOVERED). Mixed identity by design; never a client list.
pop_xrpl: XRPL issued-asset slice — the assets whose signed xrpl.asset.state card sits on the current public root, from the live reader, with the issuer registry artifact beside it. A read, not a rating.
pop_x402-bazaar: x402 Bazaar listings slice — the payable resources the two public discovery indexes catalogue, counted within each frame with the overlap published, plus the estate's own door census. Appearing in an index is not delivery.
pop_mcp-registry: MCP registry listings slice — every server name the estate publishes in the official registry, classified on its latest version, with the registry's full-walk census and the effect-binding server probe's counts. Distribution, not adoption.
pop_a2a: A2A registry population slice — the agents enumerable without a credential from the public A2A registry frame, with the estate's own directory-listing state. A frame count, not a global count.
pop_ots-proofs: OpenTimestamps proof manifest slice — every published .ots proof of an estate artifact with the state its bytes were read into (Bitcoin-attested, calendar-pending, subject absent). A pending proof is not anchored.
pop_layer0: Layer-0 ceremony slice — every rail and probe of the estate's own machine surface at the ceremony's as_of with the HTTP status returned, and the ceremony artifact's .ots state. Self-attestation, dated.
pop_corrections: Corrections ledger slice, full history — every published correction (what was wrong, how it was caught, the fix, dated) with a per-entry content digest. The free /api/corrections stays free; this meters the assembled slice.
pop_claim-watch: Claim-maintenance registries slice — each published registry of a vendor's public claims (captured verbatim, hashed, source-cited, each with a measurement plan) with the file's digest, digest-reproducibility and .ots state read from bytes. CLAIM_CAPTURED, never a claim of falsity.
ras_mcp_probe: MCP discovery probe receipt — one live read-only discovery of a public https MCP endpoint (server/discover, else initialize + tools/list; no tool is ever called): state, requested vs negotiated protocol version, tool count and tool-names sha256, Ed25519-signed. A probe, not a grade.
ras_x402_check: x402 challenge conformance receipt — one live GET of a public x402 resource scored by the daily census rule (HTTP 402, PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, x402Version 2 and extensions.bazaar in the body), Ed25519-signed. A non-conformant result is delivered as found.
ras_supply: Token supply read receipt — one fresh totalSupply() read of an issuer-listed EVM deployment (USDC, address parsed from the issuer page on the request); on Ethereum the EIP-1186 storage proof is checked against the block stateRoot, elsewhere it is labelled OPERATOR_API. Not a reserve attestation.
